### Fish, Taxes, and the Call to Love Anyway
Author: Rev. Dr. Ron Bell
Site: The Upper Room
URL: https://www.upperroom.org/news/2910
Passage: Matthew 17:27
Points:
- As the Son of God, Jesus had the right to be exempt from the temple tax.
- Rather than asserting His rights or demanding His way, Jesus chose not to cause others to stumble.
- True spiritual leadership emphasizes connection, empathy, and grace over winning arguments.
- Believers are challenged to exercise restraint so their words and actions do not hinder others from seeing Christ.

### Jesus Provides a Shekel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-provides-shekel
Passage: Matthew 17:27
Points:
- The temple tax originated under Moses for tabernacle maintenance and redemption.
- As the Son of God who fulfills the temple's true purpose, Jesus and His followers were exempt from the requirement.
- Jesus paid the tax through a miraculous provision to avoid setting up an unnecessary stumbling block to the gospel.
- Following Christ's example, believers should hold their personal freedoms lightly to protect weaker consciences.
